description: Relationship Pattern Diagnostic - A psychologically-informed diagnostic quiz with weighted pattern matching.

userStories.title: Content System (CMS) Schema Setup
userStories.description: As a content manager, I need a database structure to store questions, answers, and their associated weights so that I can tune the diagnostic engine without redeploying the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `questions` table (id, text, type [mc/text], phase [early/mid/late]) in Supabase
Create `answers` table (id, question_id, text, weight_pattern, weight_driver, weight_reinforcement) in Supabase
Create `results` table (id, cluster_id, type [primary/secondary], content_markdown) in Supabase
Seed initial data with placeholder content for all 5 clusters
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Supabase project created (bzsjivgykaclmmovugiz), tables defined and seeded.

userStories.title: Diagnostic Engine (State Management)
userStories.description: As a user, I need the system to track my internal 'Vulnerability' scores across three axes as I answer questions, without assigning me to a fixed path.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement a state machine/store to track scores for: Pattern Axis, Driver Axis, Reinforcement Axis
Logic to update weighted probabilities when an answer is selected
Logic to pair Primary + Secondary vulnerabilities based on the 'Internal Matrix' rules
Unit tests to verify that specific answer combinations lead to expected Clusters (C1-C5)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Zustand store implemented with persistent state. Scoring logic and primary/secondary cluster determination verified by Vitest unit tests.

userStories.title: Quiz Interface - Phase 1 & 2 (Multiple Choice)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clean, clinical interface to answer multiple-choice questions so that I can progress through the diagnostic with low friction.
acceptanceCriteria: Render questions one by one with a progress indicator
Interface adheres to 'Clean & Clinical' aesthetic (minimalist, serif fonts, trustworthy)
Smooth transitions between questions
Display 'early' and 'mid' phase questions
Handle conditional logic if data supports it
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Quiz interface implemented with 'Editorial Serenity' theme. Supabase fetching for Phase 1 & 2 integration verified via browser testing.

userStories.title: Quiz Interface - Phase 3 (Reflections)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to answer open-ended reflection questions to deepen my emotional investment in the process.
acceptanceCriteria: Support text-area input for 'Written Reflections'
Store reflections in local state
Ensure styling matches clinical aesthetic
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Results Teaser & Payment Gate
userStories.description: As a user, upon finishing the quiz, I want to see a revealing teaser of my results and an option to unlock the full report.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculate final result (Primary + Secondary) locally
Display 'Teaser' view: Summary with blurred details
Integrate Stripe Checkout (or mock for dev) for payment
Handle 'Unlock' state post-payment
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Full Report Rendering
userStories.description: As a paid user, I want to read my full, detailed diagnostic report to understand my relationship patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Render the full report content fetched from the DB based on the calculated result
Sections: Combined Profile, Internal Deep Dives, Interaction Layer
Aesthetics: Web-native, scrollable, editorial style
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
